verdict.rationale: Sentry ingests both OpenTelemetry traces and logs into one platform via OTLP, and the Trace Explorer lets developers explore span samples and attributes. That points to unified telemetry. However, no evidence documents actually jumping from a span to its correlated logs or metrics, and metrics correlation is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: documented span-to-log navigation, span-to-metrics correlation, end-to-end request debugging workflow docs, independent/hands-on corroboration.
